_comment: LOCAL business-process catalog in the style of SAP's Reference Business Architecture (process group > process module). Written by the project, not published by SAP: ids and module names are project aliases. Replace or extend with the official SAP reference snapshot when it is available (keep ids stable or add an 'alias_of' field). Segments/activities are intentionally not modelled.

modules.name: Opportunity to Quote
modules.description: inquiries, quotations, contracts and pricing agreements with customers

modules.name: Order to Fulfill
modules.description: sales order management, availability, order changes, EDI order intake

modules.name: Deliver to Customer
modules.description: outbound deliveries, picking, packing, goods issue, shipment

modules.name: Invoice to Cash
modules.description: billing, receivables, credit, dunning, collections, cash application

modules.name: Service to Cash
modules.description: customer service orders, repairs, warranty, returns

modules.name: Manage Customer Data
modules.description: customer master sales and finance views

modules.name: Source to Contract
modules.description: RFQs, quotations, contracts, scheduling agreements, source lists, supplier evaluation

modules.name: Procure to Receive
modules.description: requisitions, purchase orders, release strategies, confirmations, goods receipt

modules.name: Procure Services
modules.description: service purchase orders and service entry sheets

modules.name: Invoice to Pay
modules.description: supplier invoice verification, payables, payment runs, payment media

modules.name: Manage Supplier Data
modules.description: vendor master purchasing and finance views

modules.name: Forecast to Plan
modules.description: demand management, MRP, planned orders, capacity

modules.name: Plan to Produce
modules.description: production and process orders, confirmations, repetitive manufacturing, production master data

modules.name: Make to Inspect
modules.description: inspection lots, results, usage decisions, quality notifications, inspection planning

modules.name: Receive to Inventory
modules.description: goods movements, stock, physical inventory, batches

modules.name: Store to Pick
modules.description: warehouse management, transfer orders, bins, RF

modules.name: Plan to Transport
modules.description: shipments, freight, transportation planning

modules.name: Manage Product Data
modules.description: material master, variant configuration, handling-unit setup

modules.name: Post to Ledger
modules.description: general ledger postings, documents, ledgers, special ledgers

modules.name: Close to Report
modules.description: period and year-end closing, valuations, reclassifications, financial statements

modules.name: Manage Cost Accounting
modules.description: cost centers, internal orders, allocations, settlements

modules.name: Cost Products
modules.description: product costing, material ledger, WIP, variances

modules.name: Analyze Profitability
modules.description: CO-PA, profit center accounting, margin reporting

modules.name: Manage Taxes
modules.description: VAT, withholding, country tax reporting

modules.name: Manage Cash and Banks
modules.description: bank statements, lockbox, cash management, house banks

modules.name: Recruit to Onboard
modules.description: recruitment, applicants, hiring

modules.name: Manage Workforce
modules.description: personnel administration, org management, self-services, HR workflows and forms

modules.name: Time to Pay
modules.description: time recording, timesheets, absences, time evaluation

modules.name: Run Payroll
modules.description: payroll, posting to accounting, payslips

modules.name: Develop to Perform
modules.description: qualifications, appraisals, training, careers

modules.name: Reward to Benefit
modules.description: compensation and benefits

modules.name: Travel to Reimburse
modules.description: travel requests, expenses, settlement

modules.name: Acquire to Retire Asset
modules.description: fixed asset accounting, depreciation, retirements

modules.name: Operate to Maintain
modules.description: technical objects, maintenance notifications and orders, maintenance plans

modules.name: Design to Release
modules.description: documents, classification, engineering change, product structures

modules.name: Plan to Deliver Project
modules.description: projects, WBS, networks, project costs and settlement

modules.name: Manage Business Partners
modules.description: business partner and address management

modules.name: Manage Common Data
modules.description: change documents, number ranges, texts, units, currencies, calendars

modules.name: Integrate Systems
modules.description: IDoc/ALE/EDI, RFC, web services, OData, Fiori infrastructure

modules.name: Run Workflow Technology
modules.description: generic workflow technology and tooling

modules.name: Produce Output
modules.description: forms, printing, email, files

modules.name: Secure and Authorize
modules.description: users, roles, authorizations

modules.name: Operate and Develop
modules.description: utilities, jobs, transports, development tools, UI frameworks

modules.name: Extract for Analytics
modules.description: BW extractors and data sources

modules.name: Group, Peg and Distribute
modules.description: grouping of WBS elements / requirements, pegging of supply to demand across projects, distribution of costs and inventory values (SAP A&D GPD / PMMO)

modules.name: Manage Program and Project Manufacturing
modules.description: program structures, project-based manufacturing, project stock and MRP per project (PMMO)

modules.name: Account for Government Contracts
modules.description: cost-plus and fixed-price contracts, progress billing, resource-related billing, earned value, DCAA/FAR/CAS compliance reporting

modules.name: Control Configuration and Effectivity
modules.description: serial and parameter effectivity, as-designed / as-built / as-maintained configuration, engineering change control

modules.name: Maintain, Repair and Overhaul
modules.description: MRO of own fleet or customer equipment, component repair, exchange, rotables, flight logs

modules.name: Engineer and Execute Production (PEO)
modules.description: S/4HANA Production Engineering and Operations: shop floor routing, work instructions, change records; target concept, no ECC source rules

modules.name: Not mapped to a business process yet
modules.description: code whose business process is not in this catalog, or could not be determined; a queue to revisit when the catalog is extended or the official SAP reference is loaded
